### Wisdom from the Psalms 10/21
Author: Crosswalk.com
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wisdom/wisdom-from-the-psalms-10-or-21-552644.html
Passage: Psalm 126:2
Points:
- Christian faith should be accompanied by visible joy, laughter, and delight.
- Portraying faith only as somber or solemn can push non-believers away.
- Believers can show others that a life following God is joyful and lively.
- Living with joy serves as an attractive witness of God's goodness to the world.

### A Geyser of Saving Joy
Author: Erik Raymond
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/erik-raymond/a-geyser-of-saving-joy/
Passage: Psalm 126:1-3
Points:
- Believers should continually remember the awe and wonder of their initial salvation in Christ.
- The return of Zion's captives was so extraordinary that it felt like a dream filled with laughter.
- Deliverance from the guilt and bondage of sin is even greater than release from physical exile.
- Meditating on God's saving mercy fuels joyful worship, personal contentment, and active evangelism.
